overview: This enum chooses which set of battle attack lines a customizable voice pack replaces.

None.simple: An empty voice category with no attack voice pack.
None.technical: Declared as the zero value of the uint8 enum and used as the default of FGameDataTableRow_CharacterCustomVoice::Category. PreviewVoice has no case for it and returns before playing a sample. The item icon switch also leaves the background Transparent for any unhandled category. No exported CharacterCustomVoiceDataTable row uses this value.

NormalAttack.simple: A voice pack that changes a character normal attack lines.
NormalAttack.technical: Declared as uint8 slot 1. CollectVoiceSamples filters CharacterCustomVoiceDataTable rows by this category and collects their Id_Voice_Sample into NormalAttackVoiceSamples keyed by IndexType. PreviewVoice picks that sample map, and the item icon uses NormalAttack_Default, NormalAttack_TypeA, or NormalAttack_TypeB for the three index types. Save validation checks literal category 1 against the first value of each character voice pair, and the customize tile sets VoiceCategory to 1 and item type 2. The export has 81 rows of this category.

CursedEnergyAttack.simple: A voice pack that changes a character Cursed Energy attack lines.
CursedEnergyAttack.technical: Declared as uint8 slot 2. CollectVoiceSamples filters CharacterCustomVoiceDataTable rows by this category and collects their Id_Voice_Sample into CursedEnergyAttackVoiceSamples keyed by IndexType. PreviewVoice picks that sample map, and the item icon uses CursedEnergyAttack_Default, CursedEnergyAttack_TypeA, or CursedEnergyAttack_TypeB. Save validation checks literal category 2 against the second value of each character voice pair, and the customize tile sets VoiceCategory to 2 and item type 3. The export has 81 rows of this category.

Invalid.simple: A reserved invalid marker for voice packs.
Invalid.technical: Declared as the uint8 slot 255 in the enum header. PreviewVoice and the item icon switch have default branches that would treat it as an unhandled category, but no explicit comparison against Invalid exists in this checkout and no exported row carries it. Its intended runtime behavior is unresolved.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_CharacterCustomVoice defaults Category to None. All 162 exported rows use either NormalAttack or CursedEnergyAttack with 81 rows each.
The category pairs with EGameCustomVoiceIndexType. The index type picks the Default, TypeA, or TypeB variant inside a category, and the item icon color depends on both values.
Voice preview and the shop sample preview reuse CollectVoiceSamples, so the category controls which sample list supplies the audition clips in both screens.

The saved customization stores one numeric index per category for each character. Save sanitization validates index 1 against category 1 and index 2 against category 2, then requires an owned CustomVoice Item.
The tile lists rows by comparing the stored uint8 VoiceCategory to the row Category, and it assigns different tile item types for the two real categories.
